subtitle: Xhuma amapheya afanayo
short_description: Xhuma ipheya ngalinye lezinhlamvu ngendlela egcwalisa igridi yonke.
description:
Xhuma lilinye ngalinye lamapheya ezinhlamvu ezifanayo ngomkhondo ohamba emasikwele egridi ye-4×4. Imikhondo ayikwazi ukuqamba noma ukuhlukana, futhi kumelwe imikhondo ndawonye imboze wonke amasikwele.

Thepha amasikwele angenalutho ukuze ujikeleze phakathi komkhondo A, komkhondo B nongenalutho. Amaphuzu okuqala nokuphela amakwe ngamasongo, futhi umkhondo ngamunye unohlamvu wawo nombala wawo.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
